S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.

subtypes.Eating Very Small Amounts: Eating only one or two bites a day or extremely small portions per meal.
subtypes.Skipping Meals: Intentionally skipping breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
subtypes.Exclusion of Specific Food Groups: Strictly avoiding specific food groups like carbohydrates or fats to prevent nutritional imbalance.
subtypes.Strict Calorie Restriction: Limiting daily caloric intake to an extremely low level.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.

subtypes.Continuous Weight Loss: A state where weight continues to decrease due to intentional restriction of intake.
subtypes.Insistence on Low Weight: Attempting to lose more weight or refusing to restore weight despite already being underweight.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.

subtypes.Fear of Weight Gain: Extreme fear and loathing of gaining weight or becoming fat.
subtypes.Fear of Specific Foods: Fear that eating high-calorie foods will immediately lead to weight gain.
subtypes.Obsession with Weight Gain: Compulsively checking the scale and becoming extremely anxious about even the slightest increase.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.

subtypes.Distorted Body Image: Perceiving one's body as much fatter than it actually is or perceiving specific parts as excessively large when looking in the mirror.
subtypes.Self-Worth Dependent on Weight: Judging whether one is a good or successful person solely based on weight or body shape.

patient_info.stressor_event: Revision of personal habits (dress, manners, associations, quitting smoking)
patient_info.stressor: As Jesus prepared himself for future lieutenant candidacy, he overhauled his habits with new meal rules, a stricter gym schedule, and a more polished firefighter identity that he believed would make him look more capable and command-ready. The changes were initially praised as discipline, but his eating became increasingly restricted and his weight fell below a healthy point for his frame, despite his active work demands. He found himself measuring confidence and credibility by body shape, and the idea of gaining weight began to feel like a threat to the image he was trying to maintain. Jesus sought psychiatric care himself after a department fitness review noted the weight concern and he realized his fear of weight gain was no longer fitting with the practical, steady approach he valued in himself.

S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.
S043.manifestation: I came in because what started as eating cleaner for the lieutenant track has turned into me cutting meals down to things like black coffee, a protein shake, and a small dinner even on shift days when I know I burned way more than that.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.
S044.manifestation: My gear and station clothes hang looser now, and even after the fitness review flagged my weight as too low for my build, part of me still feels like I should keep trimming down a little more.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.
S045.manifestation: If the scale is up even a pound after a big station meal or extra water, I get this tight panic like I’ve blown it and people are going to see me as soft or out of control.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.
S046.manifestation: When I look in the mirror before work, I focus on whether my waist and face look sharp enough, and if they don’t, it messes with how confident and command-ready I feel that day.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I’m still doing my job, but I’ve started ducking out of station meals and keeping to myself when the crew orders food, so I’m less part of the team than I used to be.
